purpose: Establish a deployable V2 retrieval baseline after repairing the training-serving scoring contract; this is a calibration baseline, not an optimization candidate.
hypothesis: Training the existing History-10 masked-mean two-tower model under the same scaled-cosine scoring contract used by export and online retrieval produces a valid V2 quality anchor.
single_core_variable: scoring_contract=scaled_cosine_v2 with fixed logit_scale=10.0; no architecture, split, history length, loss weighting, embedding dimension, or optimizer change.

post_run_protocol.decision: Do not define or change V2 candidate acceptance thresholds from this run alone. First report this baseline and paired-bootstrap uncertainty; freeze V2 joint gates before evaluating ItemCF or any other candidate.

integrity_rules: Use a newly created v2-aligned-baseline-seed42 external experiment directory; never overwrite an existing experiment directory.
Do not access, deserialize, or re-evaluate the sealed V1 Test split.
No deployment from this calibration baseline without a separately recorded acceptance decision.
